title: Complementary tensor calculation of all four real-scalar vacuum pole masses
relation_to_pole_protocol: Extends the completed X-specific formula to the neutral phi and D particles and independently contracts all vertices for x,y. No original result or physical input is changed.
inputs: Original Candidate 1 quartic tensor and fixed MSbar matching from prior quantum effective_potential.py, qvac_tree=(1,0,0,0), mu=.1v.
formula: Pi_i(s)=1/2 sum_k K_iikk A(m_k²) -1/(32*pi²) sum_kl g_ikl² B0(s;m_k²,m_l²), g_ijk=K_ijk_phi*v. Add tree vacuum-displacement correction g_ii_phi delta_v; delta_v from independently differentiated four-mode potential.
order: Strict one-loop squared masses evaluated at tree external mass shell; strict first-order mass expansion reported separately from square root of truncated squared mass.
checks: Each zero-momentum reconstructed curvature agrees with prior effective-potential curvature within1e-14v²
x and y masses agree within1e-14v² and match the separate X pole calculation
All nonzero cubic-loop channels have external s below pair threshold before a real integral is used
Every bubble evaluated by adaptive quadrature and independent128-node Gauss quadrature agrees within1e-11
Every strict pole mass squared remains positive
scope: Pure-new-scalar vacuum threshold only. No quantum finite-charge energy, loop-corrected soliton frequencies, lifetime, SM/gravity loops or vacuum-energy recalibration.
